## 下一项最小授权

继续前需要一项新的、独立的工具链修复授权，至少明确允许：

1. 为当前 VS 2022 安装并冻结兼容的 Windows 10/11 SDK；
2. 记录 SDK 版本、头文件路径及关键哈希；
3. 冻结 `/utf-8` 编译策略，同时保留 `/WX`；
4. 创建新的 `d3-v3-cumulative-allocation-qualification-attempt-002`；
5. 重新编译 DLL，并且只有编译成功后才执行一次原定的无算法 known-answer；
6. 仍然禁止 runner/schema 集成、调度、输入、身份映射、measured root、算法 lane、正式采集、分析、排名及赢家裁决。

sdkSelection.selectionBasis: Component is present in the exact installed Visual Studio 17.14.41 catalog and is not labeled out of support.

frozenCompilerPolicy.policy: The attempt-002 native build must use /utf-8 and retain /WX. It may not suppress C4819, lower the warning level, or disable warnings-as-errors.

executionOrdering: install the single selected Windows SDK component
freeze SDK version, paths, critical hashes, and initialized x64 environment
compile the native DLL exactly once
only if native compilation succeeds, run exactly one algorithm-free Unity known-answer process
freeze pass or failure evidence without retry
mandatoryFailClosedConditions: the selected SDK component cannot be installed or verified
SDK version, include paths, library paths, or required critical files cannot be frozen
the initialized VS x64 environment does not bind the frozen SDK
any frozen source, compiler, linker, Unity executable, PluginAPI header, protected runner, protected schema, or six-algorithm binding drifts
the native DLL compilation fails with /utf-8 and /WX
the one authorized Unity known-answer process fails, times out, throws, or fails any prospectively frozen D3-v3 criterion
